spec_match.rationale: Eleven real calls, each with the explainer's documented expectation next to the observation.

interactive.rationale: A per-case run button and run-all, with a tally.

edge_cases.rationale: This page is the edge-case suite. It found real divergences in 153+flag: setPathData([]) REMOVES the d attribute (the explainer says d=""), and an unknown or short segment drops all later segments too (render-up-to-the-error) rather than skipping just that one.

references.rationale: Links chromestatus, the explainer's Key Design Decisions and svgwg#1082.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Chrome for Testing 153.0.8010.12 headless: by default all three methods are undefined (each page shows its labelled unsupported state). With --enable-experimental-web-platform-features, getPathData/setPathData are live but getPathSegmentAtLength is still undefined. Both viewports, every control exercised, console/network clean, 0px overflow. With the flag: 10 of 11 match the explainer. setPathData([]) DIFFERS: hasAttribute('d') is false.

telemetry_health.rationale: One assertion per case. Mismatches on a supporting browser fail, so implementation drift shows up in telemetry.

accessibility.rationale: Each case has a labelled run button, and the tally is in a live status.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Case dl collapses to one column. 0px overflow.

openQuestions.title: Confirm setPathData([]) and skip semantics on Chrome 160
openQuestions.detail: Chrome 153+flag removes the d attribute for setPathData([]) and drops later segments after an invalid one. Check whether the shipping build matches the explainer (d="" kept, and only the bad segment skipped), and file a Chromium bug if not.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive control panel without horizontal overflow
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Controls should be at least 44x44 CSS px on touch screens, and components should adapt to their container so nothing overflows.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: All buttons, selects, inputs and ranges have min-height 44px. Selects inside .field are width:100% after a measured 117px overflow at 360px caused by long option text. Every page was re-measured at 0px overflow at 360x740 and 1280x800.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: drive.js runs: overflow=0 on every page/viewport; responsive-check desktop ok 1/1, mobile ok 1/1

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use native controls with labels. Announce discrete outcomes through polite status/log regions and keep rapidly changing values out of live regions.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Every control is a native button/select/input with a visible label. Outcomes go to role=status / role=log regions. High-frequency readouts (slider positions, meters) use aria-live=off and announce only on change of state.

summary: A validation and migration lab that compares the explainer's contract with live behaviour. It surfaced two real 153 divergences.
